ev.q: Soap is an outrageous comedy saga serializing the hilarious exploits of the characters
The show was created as a nighttime parody of daytime soap operas
focusing on the show's racy content
alien abduction, demonic possession, extramarital affairs, murder
The cast also included several former soap opera actors
two families who have relationships as complex as those in a Russian novel
originally ran on ABC for four seasons, from September 13, 1977, until April 20, 1981
the show's story was presented in a serial format
85 episodes were broadcast over four seasons
